Step 3. The positive operator \(T_{01370013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle T_{01370013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via spectral interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_01370011 \cdot C_01370012 \cdot C_01370013\).
